scope: Final immutable AI prompt/model/provider governance, guarded calling, durable reservations, evidence records, and Phase013 key-reference integration
testModeReason: Phase015 introduces the final AI governance schema, server-only egress boundary, quota invariants, and consumes the Phase013 key rotation contract; phase-verification-v1 section3 requires full repository regression.

engineeringRegression.discovery: vitest list --json; exact file/fullName equality, all discovered assertions pass without skip
engineeringRegression.dedicatedCardCommand: npm run test -- ai-governance provider-registry guarded-client prompt-service

cases.expected: An empty Phase014 database migrates additively to exactly 8 prompt definitions and version-1 prompts, one MOCK provider config version, one mock model deployment, 8 prompt activations, 8 disabled prompt-model activations, one immutable planning policy version and active pointer, and ai.calls.enabled=false. Bootstrap is idempotent with zero immutable-row updates. Temporary PromptConfig/AiModelConfig tables remain absent.

A consistent snapshot resolves exact prompt, model, and provider versions. Missing pointers, cross-definition/version references, content hash drift, disabled tuples, schema/capability mismatch, unknown or missing variables, and disabled required secrets return CONFIG_ERROR with zero adapter calls. Atomic tuple activation increments both pointer revisions together or not at all.

Only server-only adapter files may import provider transports. Business import scans find zero direct SDK/provider fetch usage. HTTPS, hostname allowlist, port, DNS private/link-local/loopback rejection, per-redirect revalidation with a two-hop maximum, and response-size limits reject unsafe targets without secret disclosure.

A shared total deadline and AbortSignal stop work and mark the correct state. A retry occurs only before any response byte for explicit connect/429/5xx errors, at most once, with injected jitter/Retry-After and a shared budget. First-byte, cancellation, schema, 4xx, configuration, and cost failures do not retry.

Durable reservations use atomic buckets and Decimal conservative upper bounds. Concurrent calls never exceed token/cost hard caps. NOT_SENT releases are idempotent; submission is atomically marked MAY_HAVE_BEEN_SENT before transport. Unknown, cancelled, timed-out, and lost-response reservations enter RECONCILING and remain reserved. Settle and reconcile are idempotent; each retry attempt owns a reservation.

Every adapter attempt appends one AiOutputRecord with exact prompt/model/provider versions, trace and attempt numbers, hashes, status/error, duration, and token usage. Production rawOutput is null; prompt, user-sensitive text, credentials, authorization headers, and raw provider bodies never enter evidence or public errors.

Default and disabled kill states perform zero adapter calls before reservation. Authorized MOCK activation succeeds through the guarded client. LIVE requires environment admission and an ACTIVE database key. NONE sends no credential; REQUIRED without an ACTIVE key remains at zero egress. Restart does not turn a disabled switch back on.

cases.command: npm run test -- ai-governance provider-registry guarded-client prompt-service
cases.expected: In isolated temporary copies, removing the guarded-client entry point, activation/kill check, reservation CAS, or AbortSignal makes the corresponding fixed fixture red. Restoring the source makes the complete eight-scenario collection green. The mutation observation command itself exits zero.

decisions: Create only the final governance models in one additive migration; no compatibility tables, temporary PromptConfig/AiModelConfig models, or second prompt/model system.
Keep provider interfaces and schemas free of secrets, network code, and server implementations. Server-only adapters and guarded client own egress.
Default state is ai.calls.enabled=false, MOCK provider, and all prompt-model activations disabled. The controlled CLI enables mock only through admin service, fixtures, and guarded calls.
Use deterministic fixture clocks, transport events, chunks, and usage; real adapter contract behavior is tested against isolated loopback HTTP only in test scope.
Retire AI_API_KEY, AI_BASE_URL, and AI_MODEL from runtime server requirements; versioned database config and secretRef are the only live adapter source.
Register a real Phase013 key-reference adapter against ProviderConfigVersion and PromptModelActivation and rerun two-reference rotation, failure, concurrency, and emergency revoke cases.
No public AI governance UI, Planner business, real external provider call, production traffic, or formal plan persistence in this phase.
notApplicable: Real external Provider traffic, real credentials, production deployment, human review, and public governance UI are not required or claimed.
